title_en: I Fell in Love with a Beautiful Girl
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Heartbreak tavern song with a refrain; origin unclear, I cannot name an author. 'Рефрен' lines are kept as in the source, the second line of the opening verse is my reading.

lines.en: I fell in love with a beautiful girl,

lines.cyr: во девојче танка снага очи зелени.
lines.lat: vo devojče tanka snaga oči zeleni.
lines.en: with a girl of slim figure and green eyes.
Oh, oh, how beautiful it is [x2]

lines.cyr: Една вечер јас го сретнав на порти
lines.lat: Edna večer jas go sretnav na porti
lines.en: One evening I met her at the gate,

lines.cyr: бре девојче лудо младо со друг стоеше.
lines.lat: bre devojče ludo mlado so drug stoeše.
lines.en: hey, the crazy young girl was standing with another.

lines.cyr: Па си појдов во меана да пијам
lines.lat: Pa si pojdov vo meana da pijam
lines.en: So I went to the tavern to drink

lines.cyr: да го смирам мојто срце заљубено.
lines.lat: da go smiram mojto srce zaljubeno.
lines.en: to calm my heart in love.

lines.cyr: Пивнав вино, викнав песна да пеам
lines.lat: Pivnav vino, viknav pesna da peam
lines.en: I drank wine, I called out to sing a song

lines.cyr: да си душа од срце тажно развеселам.
lines.lat: da si duša od srce tažno razveselam.
lines.en: to cheer my soul from a sad heart.
